decisions.rationale: Lead Gengar+Gyarados: Mega Gengar at 200 Spe outspeeds their entire team including Sneasler, Shadow Tag traps key targets, and Shadow Ball threatens Gardevoir. Gyarados Intimidate neuters Sneasler/Incineroar physical pressure, and both can Taunt Farigiraf's Trick Room. Backs Mamoswine (Ice Shard priority for sashed Sneasler, HHP for Incineroar) and Skeledirge (hard Sneasler wall via Unaware, resists Pixilate Hyper Voice, Torch Song snowballs).
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead plan: Gengar+Gyarados lead, Mamoswine+Skeledirge back. Key speed tiers: Mega Gengar 200 Spe outspeeds max Jolly Sneasler (189). Gyarados Intimidate + Taunt for TR denial. Skeledirge resists Pixilate Hyper Voice (Fire resists Fairy) and is immune to Sneasler's Fighting STAB. Mamoswine Focus Sash + Ice Shard = priority cleanup. Opponent likely leads Incineroar (Fake Out+Intimidate) partnered with Sneasler or Gardevoir. Watch for Farigiraf Trick Room lead — Taunt it. Corviknight/Klefki benched this game; available for games 2-3 adjustments if Tailwind or screens needed.

decisions.rationale: Lead Sneasler + Farigiraf: Sneasler's Throat Chop answers Mega Gengar/Skeledirge (Dark SE) and outspeeds non-Mega Gengar, while Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks Klefki's Prankster ThunderWave and Mamoswine's Ice Shard, plus Trick Room option. Back Dedenne (4x Thunderbolt vs Gyarados) and Incineroar (Intimidate pivot vs their physical core).
decisions.notebook: Opponent (game 1): Gengar(Mega, Shadow Tag trap, Timid, raw 143-178/165-200), Corviknight(Careful, Mirror Armor, Tailwind/Brave Bird/U-turn), Gyarados(Jolly, Intimidate, Sitrus, Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch), Mamoswine(Adamant, Thick Fat, Focus Sash, Ice Shard/Icicle Crash/High Horsepower), Klefki(Calm, Prankster, Light Clay, TW/Reflect/Light Screen), Skeledirge(Modest, Unaware, Lum, Torch Song/Will-O-Wisp/Shadow Ball). Key: Sneasler is my only reliable Gengar/Skeledirge answer (Throat Chop); Mega Gengar outspeeds Sneasler so rely on Focus Sash to survive then KO. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks Klefki Prankster + Mamoswine Ice Shard. Dedenne handles Gyarados. Incineroar Fake Out is useless vs Ghost Gengar. Plan: remove Ghost threats (Gengar/Skeledirge) with Sneasler before they pressure Farigiraf/Gardevoir; use Trick Room vs their faster leads; keep Dedenne for Gyarados.

decisions.rationale: Gengar Taunts Farigiraf to deny Trick Room (Gengar 178 > Farigiraf 80-112) and Mega Evolves to 200 Spe + Shadow Tag, outspeeding max Jolly Sneasler (189). Gyarados Crunches Farigiraf for 2x SE (26-88%), chunking key support. Sneasler at -1 Atk can't reliably KO either mon: Rock Slide does 20-67% to Gyarados (Sitrus Berry saves), Throat Chop 34-119% to Gengar but unlikely at -1. Denying TR is the top priority.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Gengar+Gyarados vs Sneasler+Farigiraf. Gengar 252 Spe Timid = 178, Mega Gengar = 200 Spe (outspeeds max Jolly Sneasler 189). Gyarados Intimidate already applied (-1 Atk on both foes). Turn 1: Gengar Taunt+Mega on Farigiraf, Gyarados Crunch on Farigiraf. Plan: deny TR, get Shadow Tag online, chunk Farigiraf. Next turn double-target Sneasler to break Focus Sash and KO with Mega Gengar (200 Spe). Mamoswine Focus Sash + Ice Shard priority and Skeledirge Unaware in back. Opponent back: Incineroar (Fake Out+Intimidate), Gardevoir (Mega, Pixilate Hyper Voice), Dedenne, Skarmory (Tailwind). Watch for Sneasler Unburden activation if sash breaks — it doubles to 308-378 Spe, outspeeding everything except priority. If Unburden activates, use Protect stalling or Ice Shard from Mamoswine.

decisions.rationale: Gengar fainted; bring Mamoswine. Ice Shard priority is essential to deal with Sneasler's Focus Sash + Unburden — break sash with High Horsepower (2x SE Ground vs Poison), then pick off at 1 HP with priority next turn regardless of Unburden speed. Mamoswine's own Focus Sash ensures survival. Gyarados can Crunch Farigiraf (2x SE, 54% HP) for the KO. Skeledirge lacks priority and loses to Unburden Sneasler.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gengar-Mega fainted turn 1 (Taunt+Mega worked, denied TR on Farigiraf, Taunt has ~2 turns left). Gyarados 100% with Intimidate already applied (-1 Atk both foes). Farigiraf 54%, Taunted, Sitrus consumed. Sneasler 100%, Focus Sash intact, -1 Atk, Unburden not yet active. Plan: bring Mamoswine, double-target to break Sneasler sash (High Horsepower 2x SE) + KO Farigiraf (Crunch 2x SE). Use Ice Shard priority to finish Sneasler through Unburden. Mamoswine Focus Sash + Skeledirge Unaware in back. Opponent back: Incineroar (FakeOut+Intimidate, Leftovers), Gardevoir (Mega Stone, Pixilate Hyper Voice), Dedenne (CheekPouch, Nuzzle), Skarmory (Tailwind, OccaBerry, Sturdy). Watch for Sneasler Protect to stall Taunt. If Unburden activates, only priority outspeeds it (308-378 Spe).

decisions.rationale: Sneasler outspeeds non-Mega Gengar (189 vs 143-178) and Throat Chop is super effective, but alone only does 35.9-90.4% (not a guaranteed OHKO). Doubling up with Farigiraf Psychic (73.1-173.3%) guarantees Gengar is removed unless it Protects, eliminating the Shadow Tag Mega threat. Sneasler's Focus Sash covers a faster Mega Gengar's hit. Farigiraf Psychic is an attack, so it can't be stopped by Gyarados Taunt.
decisions.notebook: Gengar is the top priority threat (Mega Shadow Tag trap). Sneasler Throat Chop vs Gengar is NOT a guaranteed OHKO (35.9-90.4% at -1 Atk); needs Farigiraf Psychic assist to secure the KO. Farigiraf Psychic vs Gengar 73.1-173.3% (possible OHKO). Gyarados Crunch threatens Farigiraf (26.4-88.2%, super effective). Sneasler (189) outspeeds non-Mega Gengar (143-178) but Mega Gengar (165-200) can outspeed it; rely on Focus Sash + Unburden. Plan: remove Ghost threats (Gengar/Skeledirge) with Sneasler+Farigiraf before they pressure; Dedenne handles Gyarados; Incineroar Fake Out useless vs Ghost. Consider Trick Room vs their faster leads but beware Gyarados Taunt blocking Farigiraf status.

decisions.rationale: Split targets: HH breaks Sneasler Sash (2x SE, Sneasler to 1HP+Unburden) while Crunch 2x SE on Farigiraf from 54% (~7% or KO). If Sneasler CCs Mamoswine, Sash saves it; Farigiraf Hyper Voice may KO Mamo at 1HP but next turn Ice Shard (priority) finishes Sneasler + Crunch finishes Farigiraf = 2-for-1. If Sneasler Protects, Crunch still damages Farigiraf and Mamo Sash stays intact. Doubling either target is worse (Protect whiff risk or extra turn needed).
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gengar-Mega fainted T1 (Taunt denied TR on Farigiraf, Taunt expires end of T3). Farigiraf at 54%, Taunted, Sitrus consumed. Sneasler 100% Focus Sash intact, -1 Atk from Intimidate, Unburden not yet active. T2 plan: HH on Sneasler (break Sash) + Crunch on Farigiraf (2x SE, ~47% non-crit from T1 crit inference, not guaranteed KO from 54%). Next turn: Ice Shard priority finishes Sneasler at 1HP through Unburden, Crunch finishes Farigiraf. Mamoswine Focus Sash may break to Close Combat (72-104% range). Skeledirge (Unaware, Lum, Modest, 86 Spe) in back for opponent's setup. Opponent back: Incineroar (FakeOut+Intimidate, Leftovers, 80-112 Spe), Gardevoir (Mega Stone, Pixilate HyperVoice, 120-152 Spe if Mega), Dedenne (CheekPouch Nuzzle, 133-168 Spe), Skarmory (Tailwind, OccaBerry, Sturdy, 90-122 Spe). Key speed benchmarks: Mamo 132, Gyara 130, Sneasler 154-189 (308-378 with Unburden), Farigiraf 80-112. Only priority outspeeds Unburden Sneasler.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine High Horsepower is a guaranteed OHKO on Sneasler (sash saves, Unburden). Gyarados Crunch hits Farigiraf for 35-62%, and at 54% HP Farigiraf is in KO range. Switch Farigiraf to Incineroar: Intimidate drops both foes' Attack (protecting Sneasler) and clears Farigiraf's Taunt for future Trick Room. Sneasler Rock Slide hits both, breaks Mamoswine's Focus Sash, and is super effective vs Gyarados.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Mamoswine High Horsepower guaranteed OHKO on Sneasler (Focus Sash saves, then Unburden doubles speed). Gyarados Crunch 35-62% on Farigiraf. Sneasler Close Combat vs Mamoswine 53-117% (sash saves it at 1HP). Sneasler Rock Slide vs Gyarados 18-40% (super effective), vs Mamoswine only 8-18% (breaks sash). Farigiraf Psychic vs Gyarados 25-55%; Hyper Voice 19-41% spread. Plan: preserve Farigiraf (Trick Room setter, Armor Tail) and pivot with Incineroar Intimidate. Remove Mamoswine (Focus Sash) and Gyarados (Sitrus) as priorities. Dedenne handles Gyarados (Electric super effective, Nuzzle para). Skeledirge/Klefki/Corviknight remain unrevealed threats; Klefki Prankster screens, Corviknight Tailwind, Skeledirge Unaware. Gengar (Mega Shadow Tag) already removed.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar Flare Blitz guaranteed KOs Mamoswine at 85% (Focus Sash inactive below 100%); Sneasler Close Combat also possible KO (65-115%). Mamoswine must Protect. Gyarados (130 Spe) outspeeds Incineroar (80-112) and Taunts it, blocking Parting Shot pivot and Will-O-Wisp for 3 turns—forcing Flare Blitz into Mamoswine's Protect or NVE on Gyarados (21-38%, survivable). Sneasler Rock Slide on Gyara is 20-35% + 30% flinch risk, but Gyara survives. Next turn Ice Shard priority KOs Sneasler at 1HP, then handle Taunt-locked Incineroar.
decisions.notebook: Key damage benchmarks: Incineroar Flare Blitz GUARANTEED KO on Mamoswine at any HP below 100% (Focus Sash only at full). Sneasler Close Combat 65-115% on Mamo (possible KO even at -1 Atk). Gyarados Waterfall 48.5-107% on Incineroar at -1 Def (possible KO, not guaranteed). Sneasler Rock Slide 20-35% on Gyara (SE spread, 30% flinch). Incineroar Flare Blitz NVE on Gyara 21-38%. Taunt on Incineroar blocks Parting Shot + WoW for 3 turns, forcing Flare Blitz only. Plan T4: Ice Shard KOs Sneasler (priority beats Unburden 308-378), then Waterfall Incineroar. Skeledirge (Unaware, Lum, Modest 86 Spe) in back for opponent setup. Opponent back: Gardevoir (Mega Stone, Pixilate HyperVoice 120-152 Spe if Mega), Dedenne (CheekPouch Nuzzle 133-168 Spe), Skarmory (Tailwind OccaBerry Sturdy 90-122 Spe), Farigiraf (54% HP, Taunt expires end T3, can TR on T4). Gengar-Mega fainted T1.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine's Focus Sash is inactive (at 85% HP, not full), so Sneasler's Close Combat (53-117%) has a real chance to KO it or leave it near-dead; Sneasler moves first at 378. Incineroar is Defense -1 and vulnerable to Mamoswine High Horsepower (possible OHKO), so switch it out safely to Dedenne before moves; Dedenne is fast and handles Gyarados. Preserves Farigiraf for later.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Mamoswine Focus Sash only activates at full HP, so once it's below full it can be KO'd normally; Sneasler Close Combat vs Mamoswine 53-117% (KO if roll >=85% at 85% HP). Incineroar at Defense -1 is vulnerable: Mamoswine High Horsepower 60-105% (possible OHKO), Gyarados Waterfall 48-86%. Gyarados Crunch 35-62% on Farigiraf; Farigiraf Psychic vs Gyarados 25-55%. Plan: preserve Farigiraf (Trick Room/Armor Tail), pivot Incineroar to re-apply Intimidate, Dedenne handles Gyarados (Nuzzle para, Thunderbolt). Unrevealed threats: Corviknight (Tailwind), Klefki (Prankster screens), Skeledirge (Unaware). Opponent team is slow overall, so Trick Room may help them more than us; use it selectively.

decisions.rationale: Ice Shard (+1 priority) KOs Sneasler at 1% before Unburden speed matters, removing its Close Combat/Rock Slide threat. Gyarados Protects to dodge Dedenne's 4x SE Thunderbolt (55-193%, likely OHKO). Next turn: 2v1 vs Dedenne + incoming Incineroar/Farigiraf with both our mons alive.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 T4 plan: Ice Shard KOs 1% Sneasler via priority; Gyara Protects Dedenne's 4x SE Electric. Opponent back: Incineroar 99% (Leftovers, Intimidate, Adamant 80-112 Spe, Flare Blitz KOs Mamo below 100%), Farigiraf 54% (Sitrus consumed, ArmorTail, Modest 80-112 Spe, can TR now that Gengar Taunt expired). Dedenne Taunted T3, expires end T4. Key: keep Gyara alive for Incineroar (Waterfall at -1 Atk does ~48-107% on Incineroar at -1 Def). Skeledirge in back (Unaware, Lum, Modest 86 Spe) counters setup. Mamo Focus Sash intact but won't trigger at 85% HP. Sneasler Unburden active (308-378 Spe) but irrelevant if KO'd by priority.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler at 1% is a sac; Close Combat is super-effective on Mamoswine (53-117%, chance to KO at 85% HP since its Focus Sash is inactive below full). Dedenne Thunderbolt guaranteed-KOs Gyarados (83-176% vs 73%). This removes both active threats or leaves Mamoswine at low HP for Incineroar/Farigiraf to finish.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Mamoswine Focus Sash only activates at full HP, so below full it dies normally. Dedenne's Electric moves (Nuzzle/Thunderbolt/Volt Switch) are immune to Mamoswine (Ground), so Dedenne can never damage it; finish Mamoswine with Incineroar Flare Blitz (Fire 2x vs Ice) or Farigiraf. Incineroar Intimidate re-applies on each switch-in. Mamoswine High Horsepower vs Incineroar at -2 atk is 24-78% (Incineroar survives); at -1 atk 33-102% (possible OHKO). Gyarados Waterfall vs Incineroar at -2 atk 19-64%. Sneasler Close Combat vs Mamoswine at -1 atk 53-117% (crit guarantees OHKO). Opponent back threats: Corviknight (Tailwind, Mirror Armor), Klefki (Prankster screens, Light Clay), Skeledirge (Unaware, Torch Song). Opponent team is slow overall, so Trick Room may help them; use Farigiraf Trick Room selectively. Preserve Farigiraf (Armor Tail blocks priority) and Incineroar (Intimidate pivot).

decisions.rationale: Sneasler fainted; bring Incineroar to re-apply Intimidate, dropping Mamoswine and Gyarados to -2 Atk. At -2, Mamoswine High Horsepower (24-78%) and Gyarados Waterfall (19-64%) cannot OHKO Incineroar, so it safely survives to Flare Blitz Mamoswine (53-176%, likely KO at 85%) next turn. Dedenne is Taunted and its Electric moves are immune to Mamoswine, so it passes.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Mamoswine Focus Sash only at full HP (below full dies normally). Dedenne Electric moves immune to Mamoswine (Ground); Dedenne can only damage Gyarados. Incineroar Intimidate re-applies each switch-in. At -2 Atk, Mamoswine High Horsepower vs Incineroar 24-78% (survives), vs Farigiraf only 12-40% (Farigiraf safe from Ground), vs Dedenne 36-131% (possible OHKO). Gyarados Waterfall at -2 vs Incineroar 19-64% (survives). Incineroar Flare Blitz vs Mamoswine 53-176% (likely KO at 85%). Dedenne Thunderbolt vs Gyarados 83-176% (possible OHKO at 73%). Opponent back: Corviknight (Tailwind/Mirror Armor), Klefki (Prankster screens/Light Clay), Skeledirge (Unaware/Torch Song). Opponent slow overall; use Farigiraf Trick Room selectively. Preserve Farigiraf (Armor Tail) and Incineroar (Intimidate pivot). Plan: Incineroar Flare Blitz Mamoswine; Dedenne Thunderbolt Gyarados.

decisions.rationale: Both actives face guaranteed KOs: Flare Blitz OHKOs Mamo (109-157%), Thunderbolt OHKOs Gyara at 73% (88-138%). High Horsepower at -2 Atk doesn't reliably KO Dedenne (53-131%). Safest line: Mamo Protects (normal rate, last used T3) to block Flare Blitz; Gyara switches to Skeledirge who resists Fire (16-34%) and survives Thunderbolt neutrally (20-48%). Next turn Skeledirge can Will-O-Wisp Incineroar to permanently neuter Flare Blitz threat on Mamo.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gengar fainted T1. Both Mamo and Gyara at -2 Atk from double Intimidate. Opponent back: Farigiraf 54% (Sitrus consumed, ArmorTail, Modest 80-112 Spe). Dedenne Taunt expires end T5. Key plan: Skeledirge (Unaware, Lum, Modest 86 Spe) is the Incineroar answer—Will-O-Wisp halves Flare Blitz damage, Torch Song/Shadow Ball for chip. Mamo Focus Sash won't trigger at 85%. Keep Mamo alive for Ground STAB on Dedenne/Incineroar. Skeledirge resists Fire, neutral Electric, immune Normal/Fighting. Opponent has no Tailwind/TR active. Series tied 0-0.

decisions.rationale: Dedenne is Taunted so must attack; Electric is immune to Mamoswine, so Thunderbolt Gyarados (83-176%, likely KO at 73%). Incineroar Flare Blitz Mamoswine (72-160%, likely KO at 85%, Sash already broken). Even if Mamoswine outspeeds and hits Dedenne, Incineroar still removes Mamoswine. Aggressive double-KO maximizes board control before Corviknight/Klefki/Skeledirge come in.
decisions.notebook: Durable facts: Mamoswine Focus Sash only at full HP. Dedenne Electric immune to Mamoswine (Ground); only damages Gyarados. Incineroar Intimidate re-applies on each switch-in. At -2 Atk Mamoswine High Horsepower vs Incineroar 24-78% (survives), vs Dedenne 36-131% (possible OHKO). Gyarados Waterfall at -2 vs Incineroar 19-64%. Incineroar Flare Blitz vs Mamoswine 72-160% (likely KO at 85%). Dedenne Thunderbolt vs Gyarados 83-176% (likely KO at 73%). Opponent back: Corviknight (Tailwind/Mirror Armor), Klefki (Prankster screens/Light Clay), Skeledirge (Unaware/Torch Song). Opponent slow overall; use Farigiraf Trick Room selectively. Preserve Farigiraf (Armor Tail) and Incineroar (Intimidate pivot). Fake Out only works on Incineroar's first turn on field.

decisions.rationale: High Horsepower on Dedenne (52.9-131%, possible OHKO) removes the 4x Electric threat to Gyarados. Will-O-Wisp on Incineroar halves Flare Blitz (63.6-176.2% -> 31.8-88.1% if burn lands first). If Skeledirge outspeeds (Incineroar 80-112 vs 86), Mamoswine survives at 85%. Even if Mamoswine falls, burning Incineroar is permanent and crucial for the long game with Unaware Skeledirge as the Incineroar answer.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gengar fainted T1. Mamoswine at -2 Atk from double Intimidate (Incineroar entered twice). Focus Sash on Mamoswine already broken (85% HP). Gyarados 73% with Sitrus Berry. Opponent back: Farigiraf 54% (Sitrus consumed, ArmorTail, Modest 80-112 Spe). Dedenne 100% with OranBerry, CheekPouch, Timid 133-168 Spe. Incineroar 100% Leftovers Adamant 80-112 Spe. Key damage refs: Flare Blitz on Mamoswine 63.6-176.2% unburned, 31.8-88.1% burned. Dedenne Thunderbolt on Gyarados 4x SE 61.4-176.5% — Gyarados cannot switch in while Dedenne is active. High Horsepower on Dedenne at -2 Atk: 52.9-131%. Will-O-Wisp on Incineroar is the win condition — burned Incineroar + Unaware Skeledirge = long-term Incineroar answer. Plan: remove Dedenne first so Gyarados can function, then burn+wear down Incineroar. Watch for Parting Shot pivot to Farigiraf. Series tied 0-0.

decisions.rationale: Burn Mamoswine to neutralize its physical threat: burned High Horsepower vs Dedenne drops to 17.8-65.5% (no OHKO), whereas even -3 Atk still risks 28.7-105.6%. Flare Blitz can't KO Mamoswine (Thick Fat, 37-81%), so Wisp is the right play. Dedenne chips Skeledirge to ~6-35% while staying safe if Wisp lands. Preserve Farigiraf for Trick Room and Incineroar as pivot.
decisions.notebook: Mamoswine Thick Fat halves Fire: Incineroar Flare Blitz only 37-81% (cannot OHKO). Burned Mamoswine High Horsepower vs Dedenne 17.8-65.5% (no OHKO); unburned at -2 is 35.6-131% (possible OHKO), at -3 still 28.7-105.6%. Dedenne Thunderbolt vs Skeledirge 23-52%; vs Gyarados 83-176% (likely KO). Skeledirge Torch Song vs Incineroar only 8.4-28.2% (0.5x). Dedenne Electric immune to Mamoswine (Ground). Plan: keep Farigiraf (Armor Tail) for Trick Room vs slow opponent; Incineroar Intimidate re-applies on switch-in. Opponent back: Gyarados (Intimidate, Sitrus) at 73%. Avoid Nuzzle on Skeledirge if Trick Room planned (paralyze would make it move first under TR).

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Switch Skeledirge→Gyarados for Intimidate (weakens Incineroar's Flare Blitz, preserves 22% Skeledirge) while Mamoswine HH chips Farigiraf to 17-34%. If Farigiraf Protects, no TR and we're golden. If TR goes up, Farigiraf is nearly dead and we still have 3v2 with Gyarados threatening Waterfall OHKO on Incineroar. Avoids risk of Skeledirge being KO'd before acting.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gengar fainted T1. Mamoswine -2 Atk from double Intimidate, Focus Sash broken. Gyarados 73% Sitrus Berry. Opponent brought Incineroar/Sneasler/Dedenne/Farigiraf; Sneasler+Dedenne fainted. Incineroar 100% Leftovers Adamant 80-112 Spe. Farigiraf 54% ArmorTail Modest 80-112 Spe (Sitrus consumed). Key damage: Flare Blitz on Mamoswine 54.5-80.2% (Thick Fat applied, 2x SE→effectively neutral). Gyarados Waterfall on Incineroar 41.6-112.9% (possible OHKO). Mamoswine HH on Farigiraf at -2 Atk: 19.8-36.9%. Skeledirge Torch Song on Farigiraf: 29.5-54.4%. Farigiraf Psychic on Mamoswine: 48.7-72.2%. Incineroar Flare Blitz on Skeledirge: 19.2-28.1% (0.5x). Will-O-Wisp immune on Incineroar (Fire type). Parting Shot can't switch (no bench mons left). Plan: bring Gyarados for Intimidate+Waterfall threat, chip/KO Farigiraf to prevent or play around Trick Room, then clean up Incineroar. Series tied 0-0.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Incineroar)
decisions.rationale: Set Trick Room with Farigiraf: it survives Mamoswine's -2 High Horsepower (~20-29%) and Skeledirge can't Shadow Ball it (immune). Incineroar burns Mamoswine to halve its attack, cutting the double-target KO risk on Farigiraf and weakening Mamoswine all game. Under TR next turn we move first and Farigiraf Psychic reliably KOs Skeledirge (31.8-58.7% vs 22%).
decisions.notebook: Mamoswine Thick Fat halves Fire (Flare Blitz ~37-81%, no OHKO). Burn halves Mamoswine physical. Mamoswine High Horsepower at -2: 36.6-53.5% to Incineroar, 19.8-29.1% to Farigiraf; burned ~9.7-14.5%. Skeledirge Torch Song 29.5-44.1% to Farigiraf; Shadow Ball immune vs Farigiraf. Farigiraf Psychic reliably KOs Skeledirge at low HP. Opponent back: Gyarados (Intimidate, Sitrus) at 73%. Plan: keep TR up, KO Skeledirge with Psychic, then handle burned Mamoswine + Gyarados under TR where our 80-speed mons move first. Incineroar has no healthy bench (Sneasler/Dedenne fainted) so Parting Shot switch fails; Fake Out unusable (already on field).

decisions.rationale: Focus-fire Farigiraf: Ice Shard (priority +1) chips 4-8.7%, then Crunch (2x SE) does 22.9-51.3%. Combined min 26.9% > 25% HP = guaranteed KO if no Protect. Mamoswine likely dies to Flare Blitz (guaranteed KO from 79%) but is dead weight (burned, -2 Atk, Sash gone). Even if Farigiraf Protects, chip drops it to ~16-21%, making next turn's Crunch a guaranteed KO. Trade removes TR setter, leaving 2v1 vs Incineroar.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gengar fainted T1. Opponent brought Incineroar/Sneasler/Dedenne/Farigiraf; Sneasler+Dedenne fainted. Only Incineroar (100%, Leftovers, Adamant, 80-112 Spe) and Farigiraf (25%, Sitrus consumed, Modest, 80-112 Spe) remain. No bench for opponent. My remaining: Gyarados (73%, Sitrus consumed, Jolly, 130 Spe, -1 Atk), Skeledirge (22%, Lum Berry, Modest, 86 Spe). TR active 4 turns. Key damage: Gyarados Crunch on Farigiraf 22.9-51.3% (2x SE). Mamoswine Ice Shard on Farigiraf 4-8.7%. Combined guarantees KO at 25%. Incineroar Flare Blitz guaranteed KO on Mamoswine from 79%. Gyarados Waterfall on Incineroar 32.7-71.8% (2x SE, won't OHKO). Incineroar Flare Blitz on Skeledirge 19.2-28.1% (0.5x). Skeledirge Torch Song on Farigiraf 29.5-54.4%. Plan: KO Farigiraf this turn, then 2v1 vs Incineroar with Gyarados Waterfall + Skeledirge support. Series tied 0-0.

decisions.rationale: Under Trick Room our 80-speed mons act first. Gyarados Crunch KOs Farigiraf from 26% (39.6-66.7% of max), so Farigiraf must Protect to stay alive as our only Skeledirge answer. Incineroar burns Gyarados (the main unburned threat) to halve its Waterfall/Crunch; Mamoswine is already burned and -2. This preserves the win condition: keep Farigiraf up to Psychic-KO Skeledirge later.
decisions.notebook: Mamoswine: Thick Fat halves Fire, Focus Sash intact (not consumed), burned, atk -2. Gyarados: Intimidate, Sitrus, Jolly; Crunch KOs Farigiraf from 26% HP. Skeledirge 22% HP, LumBerry intact, Unaware; Farigiraf Psychic reliably KOs it. Farigiraf is our only Skeledirge answer, so keep it alive. Under Trick Room our 80-speed mons (Incineroar, Farigiraf) move before all foe actives. Plan: neutralize Gyarados via burn, then KO Skeledirge with Farigiraf Psychic, then clean up burned Mamoswine. Incineroar has no healthy bench (Sneasler/Dedenne fainted) so Parting Shot switch fails; Fake Out unusable while on field.

decisions.rationale: Switch Mamoswine to Skeledirge to redirect Incineroar's likely Flare Blitz to a NVE target (10.4-22.9% vs 22% HP, ~93% survival). Skeledirge Torch Song (13.7-25.1%) + Gyarados Crunch (18.5-34.9%) combined = 32.2-60.0%, guaranteeing Farigiraf KO at 25% if both connect. Farigiraf's Protect is at reduced rate. Preserves Mamoswine on bench for late game.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Gengar fainted T1. Opp brought Incineroar/Sneasler/Dedenne/Farigiraf; Sneasler+Dedenne fainted. Only Incineroar (100%, Leftovers, Adamant, 80-112 Spe, -1 Atk) and Farigiraf (25%, Sitrus consumed, Modest, 80-112 Spe, Armor Tail blocks priority) remain. My remaining: Gyarados (67%, brn, Sitrus consumed, Jolly, 130 Spe, 169 Atk), Mamoswine (73%, brn, -2 Atk, Focus Sash intact, Adamant, 132 Spe, 200 Atk), Skeledirge (22%, Lum Berry, Modest, 86 Spe, SPA 81). Key damage: Gyarados Crunch on Farigiraf 18.5-34.9% (burned, 2x SE). Skeledirge Torch Song on Farigiraf 13.7-25.1% (SPA 81). Combined guarantees KO from 25%. Incineroar Flare Blitz on Mamoswine 71.7-105.9% (2x SE, ~96% KO from 73%). Flare Blitz on Skeledirge 10.4-22.9% (0.5x NVE, -1 Atk, ~93% survival from 22%). Flare Blitz on Gyarados NVE. Mamoswine High Horsepower on Incineroar 19.3-35.3% (-2 Atk, burned, 2x SE). Gyarados Waterfall on Incineroar 32.7-71.8% (2x SE, pre-burn). Plan: KO Farigiraf T9 via Skeledirge switch-in + Gyarados Crunch, then 2v1 vs Incineroar with Gyarados Waterfall as primary damage. Series tied 0-0.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Under Trick Room our 80-speed mons act first. Both foes are burned and atk-dropped, so their attacks on Farigiraf (Crunch 11.9-21.1%, High Horsepower 7.9-14.5%) and Incineroar are too weak to KO us this turn. Safest high-value play: double-target Mamoswine (73%, sash broken since not full HP) with Farigiraf Psychic + Incineroar Flare Blitz for the best KO chance, then clean up Gyarados next turn while keeping Farigiraf alive for Skeledirge.
decisions.notebook: Mamoswine: Thick Fat halves Fire, Focus Sash intact but broken (not full HP so it won't trigger), burned, atk -2. Gyarados: Intimidate, Sitrus, Jolly, burned, atk -1. Both foes' attacks are now weak vs our mons (Crunch ~12-21% on Farigiraf, High Horsepower ~8-15% on Farigiraf, ~15-27% on Incineroar). Farigiraf is our only Skeledirge answer; keep it alive. Skeledirge 22% HP, LumBerry intact, Unaware; Farigiraf Psychic reliably KOs it. Incineroar has no healthy bench (Sneasler/Dedenne fainted) so Parting Shot switch fails. Plan: KO Mamoswine and Gyarados under Trick Room, then bring in Skeledirge and KO it with Farigiraf Psychic. Trick Room active 3 turns.

decisions.rationale: 2v1 endgame vs lone Incineroar. Both my mons survive its Flare Blitz (Thick Fat + NVE respectively). Max damage: High Horsepower (2x SE) + Waterfall (2x SE) combined 59-131% of Incineroar's HP — likely KO, and if not, recoil + burn chip guarantee next-turn finish. No need to Protect when both survive comfortably.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: 2v1 endgame, Mamoswine+Gyarados vs Incineroar only. Opp team: Incineroar (Leftovers, Adamant, 80-112 Spe, Intimidate), Sneasler (fainted, Focus Sash, Unburden, Jolly), Dedenne (fainted, OranBerry, CheekPouch, Timid), Farigiraf (fainted, Sitrus, Modest, ArmorTail). Bench: Gardevoir (Gardevoirite, Modest, Synchronize→Pixilate 120-152 Spe), Skarmory (OccaBerry, Impish, Sturdy). My team: Gengar-Mega (fainted), Skeledirge (fainted, Lum, Modest, Unaware), Gyarados (Sitrus consumed, Jolly, 130 Spe, Intimidate), Mamoswine (Focus Sash, Adamant, 132 Spe, Thick Fat). Key notes: Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks priority moves targeting its side. Incineroar immune to Will-O-Wisp (Fire type). Mamoswine Thick Fat halves Fire damage making Flare Blitz ~neutral not 2x effective.

decisions.rationale: Down to Incineroar alone (Farigiraf fainted, no bench so Parting Shot fails). Flare Blitz on Mamoswine is the only damaging option with KO potential: 36.9-81.1% vs its 73% HP (Thick Fat halves Fire), and under Trick Room Incineroar (Speed 80) moves first. Flare Blitz on Gyarados caps at 44.1% < its 45% HP, so it cannot KO. Best chance is to KO Mamoswine and reduce to 1v1.
decisions.notebook: Mamoswine: Thick Fat halves Fire, Focus Sash broken (not full HP), burned, atk -2. Gyarados: Intimidate, Sitrus consumed, Jolly, burned, atk -1. Skeledirge KO'd (LumBerry intact, Unaware); Farigiraf Psychic reliably KOs it, so Farigiraf is our Skeledirge answer. Incineroar has no healthy bench (Sneasler/Dedenne fainted) so Parting Shot switch fails. Flare Blitz on Mamoswine ~37-81% (can KO at 73% HP); on Gyarados ~19-44% (cannot KO at 45%). Gyarados Waterfall ~25-43% on Incineroar; Mamoswine High Horsepower ~30-52%. Trick Room reverses speed; Incineroar (80) outspeeds both foes under it. Foes' attacks weakened by burn + Intimidate.

decisions.rationale: 1v1 endgame: Gyarados vs Incineroar at 47%. Waterfall is SE (2x) and can KO from 47% (25-55% range). Even if it doesn't KO, TR ends after this turn and Gyarados (130 Spe) outspeeds Incineroar (80-112) next turn to finish with a second Waterfall. Protect would waste a turn and let Leftovers heal Incineroar to ~53%, making the KO harder. Incineroar's only real option is Flare Blitz (NVE 0.5x, -1 Atk) which can't KO Gyarados from 39%.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 endgame: Gyarados (39% brn, 130 Spe, Sitrus consumed) vs Incineroar (47%, -1 Atk, Leftovers, 80-112 Spe). Waterfall does 25-55% to Incineroar (SE 2x, burn halves Gyarados Atk). Flare Blitz does 14-26% to Gyarados (NVE 0.5x, -1 Atk). Two Waterfalls should KO in most cases. Opp team fully fainted except Incineroar. For future games: opp brings from Incineroar/Sneasler/Dedenne/Farigiraf; bench Gardevoir (Mega, Pixilate, 120-152 Spe) and Skarmory (Occa, Sturdy, Impish). Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks priority on its side. Incineroar immune to WoW (Fire type). Mamoswine Thick Fat halves Fire damage.

decisions.rationale: Gyarados is the last remaining foe (all others fainted). Only viable move is Flare Blitz on Gyarados; Will-O-Wisp is useless (already burned) and Parting Shot fails with no bench. Under Trick Room Incineroar moves first. Flare Blitz (atk -1) deals ~13-29%, leaving Gyarados low; burn chip plus a follow-up next turn can finish it. Farigiraf is fainted and can only pass.
decisions.notebook: Gyarados is the opponent's final surviving Pokémon this game; all others (Gengar-Mega, Mamoswine, Skeledirge) fainted. Gyarados: Jolly, Intimidate, Sitrus consumed, burned, atk -1. Flare Blitz on Gyarados at Incineroar atk -1 is only ~13-29% (cannot KO at 39% HP); Waterfall on Incineroar ~16-29%. Incineroar is our last standing mon (Sneasler/Dedenne/Farigiraf all fainted). Trick Room has 1 turn left; after it ends Gyarados outspeeds Incineroar. Plan: keep Flare Blitzing Gyarados and rely on burn chip; if Gyarados Protects, burn still chips it. Foes' attacks weakened by burn+Intimidate.

decisions.rationale: Gyarados (130 Spe) outspeeds Incineroar (80-112). Waterfall does 39-47% of Incineroar's max HP, far exceeding its 15% current HP even after Leftovers heal. This KOs Incineroar and wins Game 1. Mamoswine is fainted so pass.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 won: Gyarados Waterfall KO'd Incineroar to close it out. Opponent's team: Incineroar (Leftovers, Intimidate, Adamant, 80-112 Spe, Flare Blitz/Parting Shot/WoW/Fake Out), Sneasler (Focus Sash, Unburden, Jolly, 154-189 Spe, Close Combat/Throat Chop/Rock Slide/Protect), Farigiraf (Sitrus, Armor Tail, Modest, 80-112 Spe, Trick Room/Hyper Voice/Psychic/Protect), Dedenne (Oran Berry, Cheek Pouch, Timid, 133-168 Spe, Nuzzle/Thunderbolt/Volt Switch/Protect). Bench: Gardevoir-Mega (Gardevoirite, Pixilate, Modest, 120-152 Spe, Hyper Voice/Moonblast/Psyshock/Protect), Skarmory (Occa Berry, Sturdy, Impish, 90-122 Spe, Tailwind/Brave Bird/Body Press/Roost). Key notes: Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks enemy-side priority. Incineroar immune to WoW. Mamoswine Thick Fat halves Fire damage. Sneasler Unburden doubles Speed after item consumption. For Game 2/3: consider leading Mamoswine + Gengar-Mega for offensive pressure; Gengar Shadow Tag traps. Watch for Trick Room from Farigiraf reversing speed tiers. Gyarados Intimidate useful for softening physical hits. Skeledirge Unaware ignores opponent stat boosts.

decisions.rationale: Gyarados outspeeds (TR ended) and Waterfall KOs Incineroar from 15% HP, so if it attacks we lose regardless. Burn chip is only ~6.25%/turn and won't finish Gyarados from 13% in one chip. Flare Blitz is the only move that can win: if Gyarados Taunts or otherwise doesn't attack, our Flare Blitz (~13-29%) lands and KOs it. Parting Shot fails with no bench; Will-O-Wisp is useless (already burned). Farigiraf is fainted, so pass.
decisions.notebook: Gyarados set: Jolly, Intimidate, Sitrus consumed, moves Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch/Protect; max HP 202. Its physical output is halved by burn and further cut by Intimidate (atk -1). Flare Blitz from Incineroar at atk -1 is NVE ~13-29% vs Gyarados. Gyarados raw Speed 111-146 outspeeds Incineroar (80) whenever Trick Room is not active, so outside TR it moves first and its Waterfall KOs Incineroar from low HP. Burn chip is only ~6.25% of max HP per turn, so it cannot reliably finish a foe from ~13% in a single turn. Incineroar is our last standing mon; Parting Shot fails when there is no bench to switch to. For future games: respect Gyarados's speed advantage over Incineroar outside Trick Room and its burn-nerfed offense; keep Trick Room up or bring faster/priority answers. Incineroar's Flare Blitz recoil is a real cost when it connects.

reflections.summary: Won narrowly on the back of Gyarados's super-effective Waterfall into Incineroar; the opponent's Trick Room actually helped Gyarados outspeed at the end. Skeledirge was a near-dead bring — sacced at 22% on turn 9 purely as a pivot, contributing nothing. Gengar-Mega also fainted before the visible timeline with no recorded impact. Mamoswine and Gyarados carried the game, but the margin was razor-thin (Gyarados survived at 13% burned).
reflections.adjustment: Reconsider bringing Skeledirge — it is weak to four of the opponent's six (Incineroar Flare Blitz, Sneasler Close Combat, Farigiraf Psychic, Dedenne Thunderbolt) and its Unaware has little to ignore on this roster. If Gengar-Mega is kept, use Shadow Tag proactively to trap a key target (e.g., Farigiraf or Dedenne) rather than letting it fall early. Lead Mamoswine + Gengar-Mega for immediate offensive pressure and trapping; keep Gyarados for Intimidate and Incineroar cleanup.
reflections.notebook: Series fc67bc1662f2; game 1 won (1-0). Opponent roster: Incineroar (Leftovers, Intimidate, Adamant, Fake Out/Parting Shot/Flare Blitz/WoW), Sneasler (Focus Sash, Unburden, Jolly, Close Combat/Throat Chop/Rock Slide/Protect), Farigiraf (Sitrus, Armor Tail, Modest, TR/Hyper Voice/Psychic/Protect), Dedenne (Oran Berry, Cheek Pouch, Timid, Nuzzle/TBolt/Volt Switch/Protect). Bench: Gardevoir-Mega (Gardevoirite, Pixilate, Modest, Hyper Voice/Moonblast/Psyshock/Protect), Skarmory (Occa Berry, Sturdy, Impish, Tailwind/Brave Bird/Body Press/Roost). Durable facts: Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks priority on its side; Incineroar immune to WoW; Sneasler Unburden doubles Speed after item consumption; Farigiraf carries Trick Room — speed tiers reverse under it. Game 1 tendencies: opponent brought Incineroar/Sneasler/Farigiraf/Dedenne, left Gardevoir-Mega and Skarmory on bench; used Farigiraf for TR setup and Incineroar as primary attacker. Plan for game 2: lead Mamoswine + Gengar-Mega for offense + trapping; Gyarados for Intimidate and Incineroar matchup; Skeledirge is a poor bring vs this four — consider replacing it if roster allows. Watch for opponent adjusting to bring Gardevoir-Mega or Skarmory.

reflections.summary: Lost because after Trick Room expired, Gyarados outspeed and KO'd Incineroar; Incineroar's resisted Flare Blitz could not finish the burned Gyarados, and the rest of the team was already gone. Team preview left no reliable Gyarados answer once Sneasler and Dedenne were down, and no Mega was brought/evolved to change the pace.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, preserve Sneasler's Rock Slide for Gyarados or keep Farigiraf alive to re-Trick Room; do not let Incineroar be the last mon against Gyarados. Bring a faster Electric/Rock answer or priority user that can actually KO Gyarados instead of relying on burn chip and resisted Flare Blitz.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Gyarados: Jolly, Intimidate, Sitrus, Waterfall/Taunt/Crunch/Protect; outspeeds Incineroar outside Trick Room and can survive a resisted Flare Blitz, then KO Incineroar. Mamoswine: Adamant Thick Fat Focus Sash, Ice Shard/Icicle Crash/High Horsepower/Protect. Skeledirge: Modest Unaware Lum Berry, Torch Song/Will-O-Wisp/Shadow Ball/Protect. Gengar-Mega: Timid Gengarite, Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Taunt/Protect. Unused threats: Corviknight with Brave Bird/Tailwind/U-turn/Protect, Mirror Armor, Leftovers; Klefki with Thunder Wave/Reflect/Light Screen/Protect, Prankster, Light Clay. Opponent uses Protect on Mamoswine/Gyarados and brings Gyarados in to Intimidate. Future: bring a dedicated Gyarados answer, keep Trick Room up or outspeed it, and avoid closing games with Incineroar alone.
